name: Volume Gradient Computation and Light Propagation Compute Shader
aliases: Gradient Computation & Light Propagation Compute Shader
definition: A compute shader that samples a 3D volume texture, computes spatial gradients using central differences, transforms gradients between world and view spaces, and initiates a per-pixel light propagation pass across volume layers.
summary: This compute shader efficiently computes spatial volume gradients via central differences and initiates per-pixel light propagation across layers within a single invocation.
